name: New Random
summary: This EA generates random trade entries with configurable direction probability, lot size, and stop loss/take profit levels. It is essentially a random-number-based trading system that opens positions without any technical analysis or market logic. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to compare against strategy-based systems.
summary_zh: 该EA基于随机数生成器产生交易信号，以可配置的概率决定做多或做空，并设置止损和止盈水平。它本质上是一个没有任何技术分析或市场逻辑的随机交易系统，主要用于实验或作为基准对比策略化交易系统的效果。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机数生成，没有任何技术指标或市场分析方法作为入场依据。入场条件是通过随机数与预设的做多概率阈值比较来决定交易方向，当随机数低于阈值则做多，否则做空。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈水平，没有移动止损或其他动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过参数直接设定交易手数，没有根据账户余额或风险比例进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险控制机制，没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤保护、没有资金比例计算，仅靠固定止损作为唯一的风险屏障。整体策略更接近赌博而非投资，不适合实盘交易使用。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is entirely based on random number generation, with no technical indicators or market analysis methods used as entry basis. Entry conditions are determined by comparing a random number against a preset long-bias probability threshold; if the random number is below the threshold, it goes long, otherwise it goes short. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or other dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user directly sets the trade volume through a parameter, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management lacks risk control mechanisms such as maximum position limits, drawdown protection, or equity-proportional sizing, relying solely on the fixed stop loss as the only risk barrier. The overall strategy is closer to gambling than investing and is unsuitable for live trading.

parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: 代码简单易懂，适合初学者学习EA开发框架
可作为随机基准来验证其他策略是否真正具有统计优势
固定止损止盈提供了基本的风险边界
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand code, suitable for beginners learning EA development frameworks
Can serve as a random baseline to validate whether other strategies genuinely have a statistical edge
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide basic risk boundaries
cons: 完全随机入场没有任何市场逻辑支撑，长期必然亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，无法根据账户状态调整风险
没有交易频率控制，可能在短时间内频繁开仓导致过度交易
没有考虑点差、滑点和市场环境因素
随机策略无法适应市场变化，不存在优化空间
cons_en: Completely random entries have no market logic support, guaranteed to lose money long-term
Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, unable to adjust risk based on account status
No trade frequency control, may open positions too frequently leading to overtrading
Does not consider spread, slippage, or market environment factors
Random strategy cannot adapt to market changes, no room for meaningful optimization
improvements: 增加交易频率限制，如每个K线周期最多交易一次，避免过度交易
加入点差过滤器，在点差过大时暂停交易以减少交易成本影响
improvements_en: Add trade frequency limits such as maximum one trade per bar to avoid overtrading
Add a spread filter to pause trading when spreads are too wide to reduce transaction cost impact

risk_points: 完全随机入场等于赌博，没有策略优势，长期期望值为负
没有交易频率控制，可能在不利条件下连续开仓导致快速亏损
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔亏损过大而爆仓
risk_points_en: Completely random entries equate to gambling with no strategic edge, negative expected value long-term
No trade frequency control, may open consecutive positions under unfavorable conditions leading to rapid losses
Fixed lot size disregards account size, small accounts may blow up from excessive single-trade loss

It is essentially a random-number-based trading system that opens positions without any technical analysis or market logic. The EA serves as an experimental or benchmark tool to compare against strategy-based systems.
